# image-to-code

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use for a supplied image/mockup and requested implementation. Interpret its
content, hierarchy, layout, and styling against the existing app.
Use authorized assets, preserve working behavior, then compare actual rendered
desktop/mobile views and states. Report reference uncertainty honestly.
Do not depend on excluded samples or promise pixel identity without measurement.
